text: Deal $5 damage. Freeze all enemy minions. Summon a 5/5 Frostwyrm.

abilities.label: SPELL
abilities.span: Deal $5 damage. Freeze all enemy minions. Summon a 5/5 Frostwyrm.

dependencies.detail: RLK_063t matches name, 5/5 and the original ID prefix; the CORE parent relation needs confirmation.
When Frozen is removed is not fully confirmed; the common case (frozen on your turn, thawed at the end of the opponent's next turn) is assumed by the executor only through this dependency.
dependencies.source_needed: Power.log of a frozen minion across two turns

decisions.question: In which order do damage, Freeze and the summon happen?
decisions.discriminating_case: The summoned Frostwyrm is friendly, so Freeze never hits it; a summon reaction that checks Frozen enemies sees them frozen under the chosen order.

decisions.question: Which characters can 'Deal $5 damage' target?
decisions.discriminating_case: Targeting your own hero is legal under 'any character'.

notes: CARD-IR-V02 expressivity example: one sequence instead of the two B1 play abilities.
